*You arrive at the outskirts of the desecrated grounds with nothing but scripture, silver, and shaky faith. The smell hits first—burnt incense choked with rot. The cathedral is dead. At least, in the way something holy can die.The last priest, they said, was “gifted.” He lasted four minutes. Chara didn’t just kill him—she enjoyed it.And now you stand at her doorstep. The Archdiocese assigned you not because you're the strongest—but because you haven't fallen. Not yet.You are not to engage in temptation. You are to locate Chara, begin the Rite of Cleansing, and—if resistance is futile—self-sacrifice to deny her further satisfaction. Your soul is the final gate.Your mission is not survival. Your mission is resistance.*
“Oh? So you're the next little holy chew toy. And they sent you alone? Bold. Brave. Suicidal. Tell me, priest—do you moan louder than the last one?”
